mapper.select: SELECT t.*, COALESCE(o.position_side, soi.position_side, pre_dispatch_role.position_side) AS position_side, o.reduce_only, COALESCE(e.operation_type, soi.fill_role, dispatch_role.operation_type, pre_dispatch_role.operation_type) AS operation_type, o.leverage_snapshot, o.price_tick_size_snapshot, o.post_fill_wallet_balance, o.post_fill_balance_at, qs.price_tick_size AS current_price_tick_size FROM ( SELECT * FROM quant_trade WHERE credential_id IN #{id} AND symbol = #{symbol} ORDER BY trade_time, exchange_trade_id, id LIMIT 20001 ) t LEFT JOIN quant_order o ON o.credential_id = t.credential_id AND o.symbol = t.symbol AND o.exchange_order_id = t.exchange_order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT credential_id, symbol, exchange_order_id, MIN(operation_type) AS operation_type FROM quant_execution_record WHERE operation_type IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSE') AND exchange_order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY credential_id, symbol, exchange_order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT operation_type) = 1 ) e ON e.credential_id = t.credential_id AND e.symbol = t.symbol AND e.exchange_order_id = t.exchange_order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT credential_id, symbol, exchange_order_id, MIN(position_side) AS position_side, MIN(fill_role) AS fill_role FROM quant_strategy_order_intent WHERE exchange_order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY credential_id, symbol, exchange_order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT position_side) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT fill_role) = 1 ) soi ON soi.credential_id = t.credential_id AND soi.symbol = t.symbol AND soi.exchange_order_id = t.exchange_order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT credential_id, symbol, exchange_order_id, MIN(operation_type) AS operation_type FROM quant_order_dispatch_ticket WHERE operation_type IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSE') AND dispatch_status IN ('ACKED', 'RECOVERED') AND exchange_order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY credential_id, symbol, exchange_order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT operation_type) = 1 ) dispatch_role ON dispatch_role.credential_id = t.credential_id AND dispatch_role.symbol = t.symbol AND dispatch_role.exchange_order_id = t.exchange_order_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.credential_id, p.symbol, d.exchange_order_id, MIN(p.operation_type) AS operation_type, MIN(p.position_side) AS position_side FROM quant_strategy_pre_dispatch_intent p JOIN quant_order_dispatch_ticket d ON d.credential_id = p.credential_id AND d.symbol = p.symbol AND d.idempotency_key = p.idempotency_key AND d.client_order_id = p.client_order_id WHERE p.operation_type IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSE') AND d.operation_type IN ('OPEN', 'CLOSE') AND d.dispatch_status IN ('ACKED', 'RECOVERED') AND d.exchange_order_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.credential_id, p.symbol, d.exchange_order_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.operation_type) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.position_side) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT d.operation_type) = 1 AND MIN(p.operation_type) = MIN(d.operation_type) ) pre_dispatch_role ON pre_dispatch_role.credential_id = t.credential_id AND pre_dispatch_role.symbol = t.symbol AND pre_dispatch_role.exchange_order_id = t.exchange_order_id LEFT JOIN quant_symbol qs ON qs.symbol = t.symbol ORDER BY t.trade_time, t.exchange_trade_id, t.id LIMIT 20001
